- [EVENT] User is thinking of trying out a new recipe for eggs benedict this weekend.
- [EVENT] User had eggs benedict at a cafe last Saturday and loved it.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a recipe for hollandaise sauce.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Hollandaise Sauce Recipe includes:
  - Ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted butter, 1/2 cup egg yolks, 1 tablespoon lemon juice, 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper (optional), salt.
  - Instructions: Double boiler setup, whisk egg yolks, melt butter, temper egg yolks, cook and whisk, season and strain, serve.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for making hollandaise sauce, including using room-temperature egg yolks and not overheating the sauce.
- [EVENT] User plans to make hollandaise sauce ahead of time and store it in the fridge.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant confirmed that hollandaise sauce can be refrigerated for up to 1 week and provided reheating tips.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for reheating hollandaise sauce include gentle reheating, using a water bath, whisking constantly, and adding warm water if needed.
- [EVENT] User is planning to prep some ingredients for the week ahead, like chopping veggies and cooking proteins.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided suggestions on how to keep veggies fresh for a longer period.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Tips for keeping chopped veggies fresh include:
  - Store in airtight containers
  - Keep them cool
  - Dry them out
  - Use the right storage location
  - Prep in portions
  - Blanching
  - Freeze them
  - Label and date containers
